- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There are several ways to get around Asturias, Spain, while on vacation: public transportation, car rental, cycling, walking, and taxi.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Public transportation includes extensive bus and train networks connecting most major towns and cities in Asturias.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Renting a car costs around €25-40 per day for a basic economy car and €50-100 per day for larger cars or SUVs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The cost of car rentals can fluctuate depending on the season and availability, and additional costs such as insurance, fuel, and tolls should be factored in.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In Asturias, Spain, May typically has average high temperatures around 18°C (64°F) and average low temperatures around 11°C (52°F).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] May is known for being a relatively dry month in Asturias, with an average of 12 rainy days throughout the month.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants in Asturias include: Casa Gerardo, El Molín de Mingo, La Taberna del Zurdo, Casa Marcial, and El Raitán de Fidel.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Casa Gerardo is a Michelin-starred restaurant known for modern takes on traditional Asturian cuisine.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Casa Marcial is another Michelin-starred restaurant offering innovative cuisine using local ingredients.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended stay duration in Asturias is at least 3-5 days to fully experience its culture, history, and natural beauty.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested attractions include coastal towns like Llanes and Cudillero, Picos de Europa National Park, and the historic city of Oviedo.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Asturias has two well-known professional soccer teams: Real Sporting de Gijón and Real Oviedo, both playing in the Spanish second division.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Taxis from Asturias Airport to Gijón cost approximately €50-60 and take around 30-40 minutes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] ALSA bus company operates services between the airport and Gijón, costing around €8-10 and taking approximately 45-60 minutes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Car rental is available at Asturias Airport, and private transfer services can also be booked in advance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mopeds can be rented in Asturias, with prices around €20-€30 per day.
